ONE CONTINUOUS WORKFLOW
Prepare, respond, and review in one place

Keep every suggestion tied to the role you are pursuing and the experience you can genuinely support.

01 · PREPARE
Select the right context

Choose a resume, job description, and optional knowledge materials for each interview. Nothing is added to a session automatically.

02 · RESPOND
Follow the conversation

Use the desktop companion for interviewer and candidate transcription, then request a Quick Answer or Screenshot Answer when you need it.

03 · REVIEW
Keep the source visible

Review confirmed questions, answer guidance, transcripts, and the materials that supported each response.

Desktop
macOS and Windows companion profiles
Web
Follow answers and session state across devices
Privacy
Raw audio is not stored by default
CORE CAPABILITIES
Built for live interviews and written assessments

Prepare, follow questions, request guidance, and review the session in English.

Realtime interview guidance

Separate interviewer and candidate audio, display progressive transcripts, and generate guidance only when requested or when Auto Answer is enabled.

Screenshot answers

Capture the selected screen through the companion and answer coding, system-design, chart, or written-assessment questions.

Personal knowledge

Build reusable material collections while selecting exactly what each interview is allowed to use.

Resume and role context

Ground guidance in your selected resume and job description without inventing projects, metrics, or experience.

Review and export

Review the session transcript, confirmed questions, answer guidance, and source provenance after the interview.

Companion across devices

Capture audio and screenshots on the interview computer while following the web workspace from another device.

RESPONSIBLE ASSISTANCE
Your experience remains the source of truth

AI output is guidance, not a guarantee or a replacement for your own judgement. Follow the interview organiser's rules and applicable recording and AI-assistance requirements.

01
Clear speaker roles

Microphone audio is labelled as you; system audio is labelled as the interviewer.

02
English end to end

English recognition, question detection, Quick Answer, Screenshot Answer, programming, and continuation prompts.

03
Regional profiles

Locale-aware presentation for the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada.
